carbon.title: Gemini 4 Carbon Model Card
carbon.significance: Carbon is the parent model from which Neon was adapted. Its card documents the starting architecture, data and infrastructure.
carbon.connection: DeepMind points to the parent card for architecture. Read Neon’s own results when assessing the adapted model.

method.title: Gemini 4 Neon evaluation methodology
method.significance: The methodology records the conditions under which the reported benchmarks were run.
method.connection: Before comparing two scores, check how each model was prompted, which tools it could use and how success was measured.
